## tal-a19-p01–p06 — ahnika 19
**SUMMARY.** [and]-:C19 atha śrītantrāloke ekānnaviṃśamāhnikam atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate / tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet / ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā dehapāte samīpasthe śaktipātasphuṭatvataḥ / āsādya śāṃkarīṃ dīkṣāṃ tasmāddīkṣākṣaṇātparam śivaṃ vrajedityartho@tra pūrvāparavivecanāt / vyākhyātaḥ śrīmatāsmākaṃ guruṇā śambhumūrtinā yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate / tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet athavā bandhumitrādidvārā sāsya vibhoḥ patet / pūrvaṃ vā samayī naiva parāṃ dīkṣāmavāptavān āptadīkṣo@pi vā prāṇāñjihāsuḥ kleśavarjitam / antyāngurustadā kuryātsadya+utkrāntidīkṣaṇam natvapakvamale nāpi śeṣakārmikavigrahe / kuryādutkramaṇaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca nirūpitam dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam / utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatve kāmacāravidhānataḥ / pūrvoktamarthajātaṃ śrīśambhunātra nirūpitam vidhiṃ pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā samayaśuddhitaḥ / kṣurikāmasya vinyasyejjvalantīṃ marmakartarīm [and]-kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham / saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm / pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā / kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ / samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt / kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt / pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet jñānatriśūlaṃ saṃdīptaṃ dīptacakratrayojjvalam / cintayitvāmunā tasya vedanaṃ bodhanaṃ bhramam dīpanaṃ tāḍanaṃ todaṃ calanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ / kandādicakragaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa hṛdambuje dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet / nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare / devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ [and]-śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ / haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet / utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate / iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati / vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet / svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayetpare / yogābhyāsamakṛtvāpi sadya+utkrāntidāṃ guruḥ jñānamantrakriyādhyānabalātkartuṃ bhavetprabhuḥ / anayotkramyate śiṣyo balādevaikakaṃ kṣaṇam kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ / sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā dadyādyadāsya prāṇāḥ syurdhruvaṃ niṣkramaṇecchavaḥ / vināpi kriyayā bhāvibrahmavidyābalādguruḥ karṇajāpaprayogeṇa tattvakañcukajālataḥ / niḥsārayanyathābhīṣṭe sakale niṣkale dvaye [and]-tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt / samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā tatpāṭhāttu samayyuktāṃ rudrāṃśāpattimaśnute / etau jape cādhyayane yasmādadhikṛtāvubhau nādhyāpanopadeśe vā sa eṣo@dhyayanādṛte / paṭhatostvanayorvastusvabhāvāttasya sā gatiḥ yathā niṣiddhabhūtādikarmā mantraṃ smaransvayam / āviṣṭe@pi kvacinnaiti lopaṃ kartṛtvavarjanāt yathā ca vācayañśāstraṃ samayī śūnyaveśmani / na lupyate tadantaḥsthaprāṇivargopakārataḥ tathā svayaṃ paṭhanneṣa vidyāṃ vastusvabhāvataḥ / tasminmukte na lupyeta yato kiṃcitkaro@tra saḥ nanu cādīkṣitāgre sa noccarecchāstrapaddhatim hanta kuḍyāgrato@pyasya niṣedhastvatha kathyate / paryudāsena yaḥ śrotumavadhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ sa evātra niṣiddho no kuḍyakīṭapatatriṇaḥ / tarhi pāṣāṇatulyo@sau vilīnendriyavṛttikaḥ tasyāgre paṭhatastasya niṣedhollaṅghanā katham / sa tu vastusvabhāvena galitākṣo@pi budhyate [and]-akṣānapekṣayaivāntaścicchaktyā svaprakāśayā / prāgdehaṃ kila tityakṣurnottaraṃ cādhitaṣṭhivān madhye prabodhakabalāt pratibudhyet pudgalaḥ / mantrāḥ śabdamayāḥ śuddhavimarśātmatayā svayam arthātmanā cāvabhāntastadarthapratibodhakāḥ / tenāsya galitākṣasya prabodho jāyate svayam svacitsamānajātīyamantrāmarśanasaṃnidheḥ / yathā hyalpajavo vāyuḥ sajātīyavimiśritaḥ javī tathātmā saṃsuptāmarśo@pyevaṃ prabudhyate / prabuddhaḥ sa ca saṃjāto na cādīkṣita ucyate dīkṣā hi nāma saṃskāro na tvanyatso@sti cāsya hi / ata eva nijaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhati kvāpi sāmaye tacchrutvā ko@pi dhanyaścenmucyate nāsya sā kṣatiḥ / śāstranindāṃ maiṣa kārṣīddvayoḥ pātityadāyinīm ityevaṃparametannādīkṣitāgre paṭhediti / yathā ca samayī kāṣṭhe loṣṭe vā mantrayojanām kurvaṃstasmiṃścalatyeti na lopaṃ tadvadatra hi / yato@sya pratyayaprāptiprepsoḥ samayinastathā pravṛttasya svabhāvena tasminmukte na vai kṣatiḥ / sādhakastu sadā sādhye phale niyatiyantraṇāt [and]-makṣikāśrutamantro@pi prāyaścittaucitīṃ caret / itthaṃ sadyaḥsamutkrāntiryoktā tāmājñayā guroḥ samayyādirapi proktakāle proktārthasiddhaye / svayaṃ kuryātsamabhyastaprāṇacāragamāgamaḥ akṛtādhikṛtirvāpi guruḥ samayaśuddhaye / adhastanapadāvastho natu jñāneddhacetanaḥ itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate / svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi / tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ ukteyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiryā gopyā prāṇavadbudhaiḥ

## tal-a19-p02 (19.11-19.20)
[and]-kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham / saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm / pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā / kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ / samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt / kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt / pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet jñānatriśūlaṃ saṃdīptaṃ dīptacakratrayojjvalam / cintayitvāmunā tasya vedanaṃ bodhanaṃ bhramam dīpanaṃ tāḍanaṃ todaṃ calanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ / kandādicakragaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa hṛdambuje dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet / nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare / devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ

source.text: [and]-śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ / haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet / utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate / iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati / vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet / svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayetpare / yogābhyāsamakṛtvāpi sadya+utkrāntidāṃ guruḥ jñānamantrakriyādhyānabalātkartuṃ bhavetprabhuḥ / anayotkramyate śiṣyo balādevaikakaṃ kṣaṇam kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ / sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā dadyādyadāsya prāṇāḥ syurdhruvaṃ niṣkramaṇecchavaḥ / vināpi kriyayā bhāvibrahmavidyābalādguruḥ karṇajāpaprayogeṇa tattvakañcukajālataḥ / niḥsārayanyathābhīṣṭe sakale niṣkale dvaye

source.text: [and]-tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt / samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā tatpāṭhāttu samayyuktāṃ rudrāṃśāpattimaśnute / etau jape cādhyayane yasmādadhikṛtāvubhau nādhyāpanopadeśe vā sa eṣo@dhyayanādṛte / paṭhatostvanayorvastusvabhāvāttasya sā gatiḥ yathā niṣiddhabhūtādikarmā mantraṃ smaransvayam / āviṣṭe@pi kvacinnaiti lopaṃ kartṛtvavarjanāt yathā ca vācayañśāstraṃ samayī śūnyaveśmani / na lupyate tadantaḥsthaprāṇivargopakārataḥ tathā svayaṃ paṭhanneṣa vidyāṃ vastusvabhāvataḥ / tasminmukte na lupyeta yato kiṃcitkaro@tra saḥ nanu cādīkṣitāgre sa noccarecchāstrapaddhatim hanta kuḍyāgrato@pyasya niṣedhastvatha kathyate / paryudāsena yaḥ śrotumavadhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ sa evātra niṣiddho no kuḍyakīṭapatatriṇaḥ / tarhi pāṣāṇatulyo@sau vilīnendriyavṛttikaḥ tasyāgre paṭhatastasya niṣedhollaṅghanā katham / sa tu vastusvabhāvena galitākṣo@pi budhyate

source.text: [and]-akṣānapekṣayaivāntaścicchaktyā svaprakāśayā / prāgdehaṃ kila tityakṣurnottaraṃ cādhitaṣṭhivān madhye prabodhakabalāt pratibudhyet pudgalaḥ / mantrāḥ śabdamayāḥ śuddhavimarśātmatayā svayam arthātmanā cāvabhāntastadarthapratibodhakāḥ / tenāsya galitākṣasya prabodho jāyate svayam svacitsamānajātīyamantrāmarśanasaṃnidheḥ / yathā hyalpajavo vāyuḥ sajātīyavimiśritaḥ javī tathātmā saṃsuptāmarśo@pyevaṃ prabudhyate / prabuddhaḥ sa ca saṃjāto na cādīkṣita ucyate dīkṣā hi nāma saṃskāro na tvanyatso@sti cāsya hi / ata eva nijaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhati kvāpi sāmaye tacchrutvā ko@pi dhanyaścenmucyate nāsya sā kṣatiḥ / śāstranindāṃ maiṣa kārṣīddvayoḥ pātityadāyinīm ityevaṃparametannādīkṣitāgre paṭhediti / yathā ca samayī kāṣṭhe loṣṭe vā mantrayojanām kurvaṃstasmiṃścalatyeti na lopaṃ tadvadatra hi / yato@sya pratyayaprāptiprepsoḥ samayinastathā pravṛttasya svabhāvena tasminmukte na vai kṣatiḥ / sādhakastu sadā sādhye phale niyatiyantraṇāt

source.text: [and]-makṣikāśrutamantro@pi prāyaścittaucitīṃ caret / itthaṃ sadyaḥsamutkrāntiryoktā tāmājñayā guroḥ samayyādirapi proktakāle proktārthasiddhaye / svayaṃ kuryātsamabhyastaprāṇacāragamāgamaḥ akṛtādhikṛtirvāpi guruḥ samayaśuddhaye / adhastanapadāvastho natu jñāneddhacetanaḥ itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate / svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi / tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ ukteyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiryā gopyā prāṇavadbudhaiḥ
